name: Spiteclaw's Swarm
inspire: Immediately after resolving a Ploy that picked a friendly fighter, Inspire that fighter.

reactions.name: Swarm
reactions.rulesText: Pick a friendly leader ({icon:leader}) to use this ability. Pick a slain friendly minion ({icon:minion}). Raise that fighter and place them on an empty starting hex then give that fighter a Raise token.

reactions.name: Scheming Pack
reactions.rulesText: Friendly schemers' ({icon:schemer}) melee weapons have Grievous ({icon:grievous}) while the target is Flanked or Surrounded.

reactions.name: Untimely Promotion
reactions.rulesText: While a friendly Skritch is slain, Krrk is a leader ({icon:leader}).

abilities.name: Skitter
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly fighter adjacent to any friendly fighters is picked to use a Core ability.
abilities.rulesText: Push that fighter 1 hex. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: Justified Paranoia
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after a friendly fighter adjacent to any friendly fighters is picked to use a Core ability.
abilities.flavorText: A Skaven must always be on their guard. Especially when around other Skaven.
abilities.rulesText: Give that fighter a Guard token. You can only use this ability once per game.

abilities.name: 'Out my way, fool-things!'
abilities.trigger: Use this in your Power step.
abilities.flavorText: Skritch and his more useful minions are well-versed in getting themselves out of danger, and into the best position.
abilities.rulesText: Pick a friendly fighter and another fighter that is adjacent to them. Remove those fighters from the battlefield and then place each in the hex the other was removed from. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Five fragile skaven, led by Skritch Spiteclaw, who hit hard by working together. Their minions are cheap, low-health bodies that the leader can raise back onto starting hexes, and Krrk takes over as leader if Skritch falls. Schemers gain Grievous against Flanked or Surrounded targets, and fighters are Inspired whenever a Ploy picks them. Once-per-game tricks for pushing, guarding and swapping positions help them escape danger, so the warband wins by flooding the board and swarming isolated foes.
